name: Edit company information
description: Update the organization’s basic company details in the Admin module and save the changes.

name: Define company structure
description: Set up organizational units and structure information such as departments or reporting hierarchy.

name: Manage job-related settings
description: Create and maintain job titles, job descriptions, and pay grades.

name: Configure skills and qualifications
description: Add and manage skills and qualification categories used in the system.

name: Manage customers and projects
description: Create and maintain customer and project records in the Admin module.

name: Set user access and security rules
description: Configure security-related settings and define access rights for users and roles.

name: Edit employee contact details
description: View and update an employee’s contact information, including work email.

name: Manage emergency contacts and dependents
description: Add, edit, and maintain emergency contact and dependent information for employees.

name: Maintain immigration records
description: Add and upload employee immigration documents and record immigration details.

name: Manage employee records in PIM
description: Store and update employee information within the PIM module.
